hebrewText: וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֮ עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה כָל הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ מְלֵאָ֤ה בְגָדִים֙ וְ/כֵלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִ֥יכוּ אֲרָ֖ם ב/החפז/ם בְּ/חָפְזָ֑/ם וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יַּגִּ֖דוּ לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
tokens.explanation: achar — depois, após, atrás, em seguida

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine

tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: derek — caminho, estrada, modo de vida, conduta

tokens.bdb: full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully
tokens.kjv: [idiom] she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.enLiteralWord: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanation: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially
tokens.explanationEn: full  or filling ; also  fulness; adverbially

tokens.bdb: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
tokens.kjv: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

tokens.bdb: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
tokens.kjv: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

tokens.bdb: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite
properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear
properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear
to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
tokens.kjv: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

tokens.bdb: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)

properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
tokens.kjv: bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.
tokens.explanation: nagad — anunciar, declarar, dizer, contar, revelar
melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação
